# Breast - Validation

**Breast cancer screening with MCED (Alternate modality) should begin only in 2025. Digital radiography should be identical between scenarios beforehand. MCED spikes every 3 years, as it should.**
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

breastScreening = importedData$Breast_Cancer_Screen_Outcome_Modality_Table %>% filter(expr_name=="Number_of_breast_cancer_screens",Hackable_province=="all",Breast_screening_modalities %in% c("Digital_radiography_mammogram","Alternative_modality_E"),Age=="all",Shiftable_year != "all",) %>% mutate(Shiftable_year  = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))

breastScreening = breastScreening %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","BaseCase" ))

ggplot(aes(x=Shiftable_year,y=expr_value,colour=sce),data=breastScreening) + facet_grid(vars(Breast_screening_modalities),scales="free")+
  geom_line()

```

**Detections should differ between all scenarios. If they are the same for MCED scenarios, then sensitivity/specificity is improper configured. CancerSeek should detect more than Galleri**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

detections = importedData$Breast_Cancer_Cases_Table %>% filter(expr_name=="Breast_cancer_detected_by_screen",Hackable_province=="all",Shiftable_year != "all",) %>% mutate(Shiftable_year  = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))

detections = detections %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","BaseCase" ))

ggplot(aes(x=Shiftable_year,y=expr_value,colour=sce),data=detections)+
  geom_line()+ggtitle("Breast_cancer_detected_by_screen")

ggplot(aes(x=Shiftable_year,y=expr_value,colour=sce),data=detections)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")+ggtitle("Breast_cancer_detected_by_screen - Smooth")
```

**MCED should be more expensive than conventional. Galleri should be the most expensive**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

breastCost = importedData$Breast_Cancer_Costs_Table %>% filter(expr_name=="Cost_of_screening",Hackable_province=="all",Shiftable_year != "all",) %>% mutate(Shiftable_year  = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))

breastCost = breastCost %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","BaseCase" ))

ggplot(aes(x=Shiftable_year,y=expr_value,colour=sce),data=breastCost)+
  geom_line()+ggtitle("Cost_of_screening")

ggplot(aes(x=Shiftable_year,y=expr_value,colour=sce),data=breastCost)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")+ggtitle("Cost_of_screening - Smooth")
```

# Colorectal - Validation

**FOBT Testing should only start in 2025 (MCED). Screening should be identical between Galleri and CancerSeek**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

colonScreening = importedData$Colorectal_Cancer_Screen_Table %>% filter(expr_name%in%c("Screens_by_FOBT","Screens_by_FIT"),Hackable_province=="all",Shiftable_year != "all",) %>% mutate(Shiftable_year  = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))

colonScreening = colonScreening %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","BaseCase" ))

ggplot(aes(x=Shiftable_year,y=expr_value,colour=sce),data=colonScreening) + facet_grid(vars(expr_name),scales="free")+
  geom_line()

```

**Cancer detections should be different between Galleri and CancerSeek.**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

colonDetections = importedData$Colorectal_Cancer_Screen_Table %>% filter(expr_name%in%c("Screen_detected_cancers"),Hackable_province=="all",Shiftable_year != "all",) %>% mutate(Shiftable_year  = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))


colonDetections = colonDetections %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","BaseCase" ))

ggplot(aes(x=Shiftable_year,y=expr_value,colour=sce),data=colonDetections)+
  geom_line()+ggtitle("Screen_detected_cancers")

ggplot(aes(x=Shiftable_year,y=expr_value,colour=sce),data=colonDetections)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")+ggtitle("Screen_detected_cancers - Smooth")

```

**MCED should be more expensive than conventional. Galleri should be the most expensive **

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

colonCost = importedData$Colorectal_Cancer_ICER_Table %>% filter(expr_name=="Cost_of_screen_x_nical_diagnosis",Shiftable_year  %in% 2020:2050) %>% mutate(Shiftable_year  = as.numeric(Shiftable_year))

colonCost = colonCost %>% filter(formattedName %in% c("CancerSeek\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","Galleri\n PPT: 90%\nMinAge: 45\nFreq: 3 Years","BaseCase" ))

ggplot(aes(x=Shiftable_year,y=expr_value,colour=sce),data=colonCost)+
  geom_line()+ggtitle("Cost_of_screen_x_nical_diagnosis")

ggplot(aes(x=Shiftable_year,y=expr_value,colour=sce),data=colonCost)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")+ggtitle("Cost_of_screen_x_nical_diagnosis - Smooth")
```

### Deaths
```{r,fig-width:16,fig-height:16}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false


deathTable = combinedTables$CancerDeaths

deathTableCombined = deathTable %>% group_by(expr_name,Shiftable_year,sce,formattedName,minAge,frequency,participation,testType) %>% summarize(expr_value=sum(expr_value)) %>% mutate(cancertype="All")

deathTable = bind_rows(deathTable,deathTableCombined)


deathTable = deathTable %>% filter(Shiftable_year %in% 2020:2050)

ggplot(aes(x=Shiftable_year,y=expr_value,colour=formattedName),data=deathTable) +
 facet_grid(vars(cancertype),scales="free") +
  geom_line()


```
